code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Fill missing cells in a repeated color sequence within each row.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors=[v for v in set(row) if v != bg]
        if not colors: continue
        fg=max(colors, key=lambda c: row.count(c))
        pos=[i for i,v in enumerate(row) if v==fg]
        # repeated spacing: use the strongest short period, then fill gaps in its span
        best=None
        for p in range(1,5):
            groups={}
            for i in pos: groups.setdefault(i%p,[]).append(i)
            for phase, xs in groups.items():
                xs=sorted(xs)
                if len(xs)>=3:
                    # Require repeated p-spaced evidence, allowing occasional omitted points.
                    score=sum(1 for a,b in zip(xs,xs[1:]) if (b-a)%p==0)
                    span=(xs[-1]-xs[0])//p
                    if score>=2 and (best is None or (len(xs),span,-p)>best[0]):
                        best=((len(xs),span,-p),p,phase,xs)
        if best:
            _,p,phase,xs=best
            for i in range(xs[0],xs[-1]+1):
                if i%p==phase and row[i]==bg: out[r][i]=1
    # Copy repeated foreground patterns from full reference rows to incomplete rows.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v==bg for v in row): continue
        for t in range(r):
            ref=grid[t]
            # Longest identical prefix. Uniform stripe references need only a short prefix;
            # patterned references need a stronger match.
            k=0
            while k<w and row[k]==ref[k]: k+=1
            ref_nonbg=[v for v in ref if v!=bg]
            if not ref_nonbg: continue
            ref_fg=max(set(ref_nonbg),key=ref_nonbg.count)
            uniform=all(v==ref_fg for v in ref)
            if k < (2 if uniform else 5): continue
            # Template must have foreground content beyond the copied prefix.
            if not any(v==ref_fg for v in ref[k:]): continue
            for i in range(k,w):
                if row[i]==bg and ref[i]==ref_fg: out[r][i]=1
    # Two-panel tasks: bottom two rows complete periodic source patterns in top two rows.
    nonempty=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v!=bg for v in row)]
    if len(nonempty)>=4:
        # detect a large uniform separator and two equal-sized 2-row bands
        top=[i for i in nonempty if i<nonempty[len(nonempty)//2]]
        bot=[i for i in nonempty if i>=nonempty[len(nonempty)//2]]
        if len(top)==2 and len(bot)==2 and min(bot)-max(top)>1:
            for r in bot:
                row=grid[r]; colors=[v for v in set(row) if v!=bg]
                if not colors: continue
                fg=max(colors,key=lambda c:row.count(c))
                # Choose matching source by the number of same foreground cells.
                src=max(top,key=lambda t:sum(1 for i,v in enumerate(grid[t]) if v==fg and row[i]==fg))
                sr=grid[src]
                # Only carry a repeated periodic run, not isolated marks.
                spos=[i for i,v in enumerate(sr) if v==fg]
                periodic=[]
                for p in range(1,5):
                    for phase in range(p):
                        xs=[i for i in spos if i%p==phase]
                        if len(xs)>=3 and xs[-1]-xs[0]>=2*p:
                            periodic.append((len(xs),-p,phase,p,xs))
                if periodic:
                    _,_,phase,p,xs=max(periodic)
                    for i in range(xs[0],xs[-1]+1):
                        if i%p==phase and row[i]==bg: out[r][i]=1
    return out
'''
